Women's Wednesday (WTFNB only), Central Park

New York, NY · Central Park · Road

Women / trans / femme

Women's Wednesday (WTFNB only), Central Park is a road group ride in New York, NY. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:50 am from Central Park (the public ride page gives no meeting point). About 18 miles, b level, 19-minute laps (about 19 mph), rotating paceline.

For visitors

Open to all women, non-binary and trans riders. To join, sign in to the club's ride app. The page asks riders to become members and doesn't say whether a first ride is free.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:50 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Wednesday (WTFNB only), Central Park group ride

A weekly dawn ride in Central Park for women, non-binary and trans riders, run by the New York Cycle Club. Three laps in a rotating paceline at B level. The club calls it a welcoming and fun ride.
